items.exampleEn: Some old fairy tales have surprisingly gruesome endings.
items.exampleZh: 有些古老的童話故事，結局恐怖得出人意料。
items.glossZh: 可怕的；令人毛骨悚然的

items.exampleEn: Students felt the lack of space acutely during exams.
items.exampleZh: 考試期間，學生們深深感受到空間不足。

items.exampleEn: Some managers are insensitive to the needs of their staff.
items.exampleZh: 有些主管對員工的需要漠不關心。

items.exampleEn: The team needs a conscientious person to manage the budget.
items.exampleZh: 團隊需要一個認真負責的人來管理預算。

items.exampleEn: Many art students scorn paintings that are too pretty.
items.exampleZh: 很多藝術系學生瞧不起太過漂亮的畫。

items.exampleEn: After a long hike, a hot shower felt like bliss.
items.exampleZh: 走了一趟長途健行後，洗個熱水澡簡直是天堂。

items.exampleEn: The constant noise from the building site was a torment.
items.exampleZh: 工地不斷傳來的噪音，簡直是一種折磨。

items.exampleEn: Big chain stores can sometimes feel impersonal.
items.exampleZh: 大型連鎖店有時讓人覺得沒什麼人情味。

items.sentenceEn: Lying on the beach with a good book is pure bliss.
items.sentenceZh: 躺在海灘上看一本好書，真是無比幸福。

items.audioEn: The hotel was clean but impersonal; nobody even said good morning.
items.audioZh: 那家飯店很乾淨，但冷冰冰的，連一個說早安的人都沒有。
items.questionZh: 說話者覺得那家飯店怎麼樣？

items.sentenceEn: She is acutely aware of how much her parents gave up for her.
items.sentenceZh: 她深知父母為她犧牲了多少。

items.sentenceEn: Worry about the exam tormented him all week.
items.sentenceZh: 對考試的擔憂折磨了他一整個星期。

items.stemEn: Our most ____ employee checks every report twice before sending it.
items.stemZh: 我們最認真負責的員工，每份報告寄出前都會檢查兩次。

items.stemEn: It was ____ of him to make jokes about her lost job.
items.stemZh: 他拿她丟了工作的事開玩笑，實在太不體貼了。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, my friends took me to see a horror film. A few scenes were so gruesome that I had to close my eyes. The story follows a conscientious young nurse who works in an old, impersonal hospital. Her colleagues treat her with scorn because she asks too many questions, and strange noises torment her during the night shifts. The ending was full of turmoil and loud music, but she finally discovers the truth and escapes. When the lights came on, I felt pure bliss: it was over at last. My friends, of course, loved every minute.
items.passageZh: 上週末，朋友們帶我去看一部恐怖片。有幾幕可怕到我不得不閉上眼睛。故事講述一位認真負責的年輕護理師，在一間老舊又冷冰冰的醫院工作。同事們瞧不起她，因為她問太多問題；值夜班時，奇怪的聲音也一直折磨著她。結局一片混亂、音樂震耳，但她最後發現了真相並逃了出去。燈亮起來時，我感到無比幸福：終於結束了。當然，我的朋友們可是從頭到尾看得津津有味。

questions.questionZh: 說話者看電影時做了什麼？
同事們為什麼瞧不起那位護理師？

items.promptZh: 他對別人的批評很不屑。
referenceEn: He treats other people's criticism with scorn.
He shows scorn for criticism from other people.
rubricZh: scorn 當名詞表示「不屑、輕蔑」（例如 treat…with scorn、show scorn for… 等）
也可寫動詞 scorn，例如 He scorns other people's criticism. 等

items.instructionZh: 用 conscientious 造一個句子，說說你在工作或學習上認真負責的地方。
referenceEn: I am conscientious about answering every email on the same day.
As a conscientious student, I always finish my homework early.
rubricZh: conscientious 表示「認真負責的」（例如 am conscientious about…、a conscientious student 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：uncharacteristic、characterization、demographically 為 u07–u10 反覆出現的干擾項，後兩者詞性與形容詞空格不同、一眼可排除
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 gruesome、appalling（形容詞，放得進 Our most ____ employee 但語意矛盾）與 bliss

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：insensitive 例句用材料「對熱不敏感」的技術義，但本課 mcq 與單元主題（性格、情緒）用「不體貼」義；卡片宜示範人際義
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 例句改示範人際義："Some managers are insensitive to the needs of their staff."

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：單字卡「主廚瞧不起速食」與 u10-l06「主廚鄙夷冷凍披薩」情境重複
